description: Move the @srobroek/harness-kit package, the harness-kit reusable workflow refs and the versions quoted in Markdown together, as one PR. Automerge patch, digest and pin updates once CI passes; minor updates stay reviewed and major updates get their own labelled PR.

packageRules.description: The package pin, the workflow tags and the versions in Markdown share one version; one group keeps them equal.
Automerge patch updates once CI passes. Not 0.x: a patch there can break.
Automerge digest and pin updates once CI passes.
A major update opens its own PR, labelled, and is never automerged.
Host modules: OpenCode supplies them at runtime. Pin them by hand to the root catalog of the OpenCode release that @opencode/* targets.
Never automerge what is not a plain dependency bump: a harness-kit bump has to regenerate files, and @opencode/* has to move with the pinned host modules. Last, so it overrides the rules above.

customManagers.description: Workflow refs quoted in Markdown: srobroek/harness-kit/.github/workflows/<file>.yml@vX.Y.Z. The tag keeps its v, as in the git tag.
Package versions quoted in Markdown: @srobroek/harness-kit@X.Y.Z and "@srobroek/harness-kit": "X.Y.Z".
